use_when: Progress Loading after the user chooses a mood, while their result is found. It ends on the green check when the result is ready
When submitting a form or saving changes
When fetching data or moving between screens

dont_use_when.when: For instant actions that finish in under a second, including a mood result that appears right away.
To decorate a screen when nothing is actually loading.
As a stack of several loaders on the same screen.
For a wait with no end.

best_practice: Show loading only when the wait is noticeable (roughly over 1 second).
Use Progress Loading when the wait has a clear start and finish, and let it end on the green check so users know it worked.

variant_intent.step=1: First of five steps; the ring has not started (code).
variant_intent.step=2: Ring drawn partway across the steps (code).
variant_intent.step=3: Ring drawn partway across the steps (code).
variant_intent.step=4: Ring drawn partway across the steps (code).
variant_intent.step=5: Ring turns positive green with a check mark. Figma: it ends on the green check so users know it worked.

a11y.fact: Has role="progressbar" with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax (5) and aria-valuenow for the step.
Named by the label prop, or "Step n of 5" by default (aria-label, aria-valuetext).
